title: Approved candidates could not register new knowledge/skills (no operator-gated path, no live-layer check)

rcca.root_cause: knowledge/skill apply paths were incomplete (wrong skill API; no live-layer validation).
rcca.corrective: learning_synth applies knowledge/skill via owner APIs, requiring a live docs/guidelines layer (fail-closed); reports applied/apply_error.
rcca.preventive: Registration is operator/approval-gated; new knowledge must resolve to live guidelines; never writes prompts directly.
